name: sh-checker
description: Run shellcheck and/or shfmt on all shell script files and include commentaries, there is a exclude parameter

sh_checker_exclude.description: Directory or file name that doesn't need to be checked

sh_checker_shfmt_disable.description: If true, it will skip the shfmt. Default is false

sh_checker_shellcheck_disable.description: If true, it will skip the shellcheck. Default is false

sh_checker_checkbashisms_enable.description: If true, run checkbashisms tool against scripts. Default is false

sh_checker_comment.description: If true, it will show the errors as commentaries in the pull requests. Default is false

sh_checker_only_diff.description: If true, run only on files changed in the PR branch. Default is false
